title: c2 diff introduces an unused import — 'type RefcheckEdit' in reference_panel_test.gleam:18 produces a compile warning
evidence: import model.{type RefcheckConfirm, type RefcheckEdit} — every RefcheckEdit construction in the file is qualified (model.RefcheckEdit(...)), so the imported type is dead. Verified by running the suite at ccc0ff6: "warning: Unused imported type ┌─ ...reference_panel_test.gleam:18:37 │ 18 │ import model.{type RefcheckConfirm, type RefcheckEdit} │ ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ This imported type is never used".
detail: The r4 N19 class of hygiene residue, newly introduced by this diff rather than carried: gleam compiles with the warning (CI stays green), but it is exactly the drift the r4 note targeted. Harmless to behaviour.
recommended_fix: Drop type RefcheckEdit from the import (keep only type RefcheckConfirm, which is used); re-run gleam test to confirm the warning disappears.

title: Take-over hook-NEGATIVE is unpinned — a menu that always lists take-over (AR-RC13 re-derivation) passes every test
evidence: overflow_menu_queued_lists_start_and_skip_test renders contact_row("rc-1", Queued) with default hooks (can_take_over: False) and asserts only "refcheck-action-start-landlord_ref" and "refcheck-action-skip-landlord_ref" present — it never asserts refcheck-action-take-over-landlord_ref is ABSENT.

recommended_fix: In overflow_menu_queued_lists_start_and_skip_test (or a sibling), assert html does NOT contain "refcheck-action-take-over-landlord_ref" with the default hooks; same negative for the Unreachable/Objected menus.
